title: Designer Dialysis Peritoneal Dialysis
brief_summary: This study aims to use modified peritoneal dialysis prescriptions to achieve adequate clearance and volume removal while decreasing the number of exchanges or time spent on dialysis, evaluating maintenance of residual renal function, and improving quality of life.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients on either CAPD or CCPD and had both residual renal (RR) Kt/V ≥ 1.0 and total Kt/V values ≥ 1.7.

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients who did not meet the values of RR Kt/V and total Kt/V specified above
